newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stock index, turnover close at record highs.
newsitem.headline: HK stock index, turnover close at record highs.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index soared to a record closing high on record turnover on Monday as overseas money continued to flow in looking to snap up big cap stocks and red chips, brokers said.
The blue-chip index rose 242.96 points, or 1.70 percent, to close at 14,574.64, a touch off the intra-day high of 14,581.35.
Turnover surged to an all-time high of HK$20.59 billion, eclipsing the previous record of HK$18.04 billion set on May 12.
"It's liquidity driven," said Percy Au-Young, research director at DBS Securities.
The record close on Wall Street on Friday and a turnaround on the property market gave the market a lift, brokers said.
"Also (May) index futures are due to expire on Thursday and this gave the derivatives traders an excuse to push up the futures market," Au-Young added.
May futures contracts surged 282 points to 14,620, a 45-point premium to the spot index.
Michael Green, property analyst at Salomon Brothers, said the index's rise came from strength in properties, in particular Cheung Kong, which jumped HK$3.00 to HK$80.00.

Developers released very little supply onto the market in April and May, while banks have been willing to finance purchases, Green said. "This has pushed residential property prices back up," he added.
Brokers also said red chips continued to dominate trading, accounting for six of the 10 most traded stocks on Monday.

Despite a lack of fresh news, continued speculative interest pushed up red-chip prices, said Ben Tam, analyst at Yamaichi International. "The Yamaichi red-chip index surged 152 points or 5.8 percent today," he said.
COSCO Pacific, the second most traded stock, soared HK$0.85 to HK$11.65.
Chu Kong Shipping jumped HK$0.975 to HK$4.575. The stock made its debut on Friday with a 200 percent gain over the public offering price of HK$1.20.
The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index for H-shares added 14.08 points, or 1.32 percent, to finish at 1,080.81.
